# capi_rollout_restart (Action)

Roll a MachineDeployment or a control plane out again without a spec change, the way `clusterctl alpha rollout restart` does: `spec.rollout.after` (v1beta2 contract) or `spec.rolloutAfter` is set to now, and CAPI replaces every machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replace every machine of a node group, for an image rebuild the template
# does not capture.
action "capi_rollout_restart" "workers" {
  config {
    kind      = "MachineDeployment"
    name      = capi_machine_deployment.workers.object_name
    namespace = "capi"
  }
}

resource "terraform_data" "image" {
  input = var.image_digest
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_update]
      actions = [action.capi_rollout_restart.workers]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Object name (a `capi_machine_deployment`'s `object_name`).

### Optional

- `api_version` (String) `group/version` of `kind`. Resolved from the installed CRDs when unset.
- `kind` (String) `MachineDeployment` (default) or a control-plane kind that supports a rollout time (`KubeadmControlPlane`).
- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Default `default`.
